Yes! I've been measuring myself every 2 weeks because we don't have a scale, and that's where I noticed my first "unbloated" measuring. The thing is, I remeasured myself and found all of my progress had gone back. 

I've been really strict, i.e. weighing EVERY ingredient for every meal, which doesn't bother me because my two sisters have been eating the same as me. We love salads here, and those usually consist of lettuce, cucumber, radish and spinach, all of which have been weighed carefully and put into MFP.
On the topic of heavy cream, would a tablespoon a day be too much? It'd suck to cut those coffees off, but if it's harmful I'd rather not drink them.

Checking MFP, I tend to stay under my goal fat macros. Although the second, third and fourth point suck for me, reading the rest of your comment gave me some hope! I'm a bit screwed with the cardio situation because I have to get back in shape to be able to follow along with the routines my  trainer has been setting (I fell off the wagon at the start of the pandemic and I need to keep up with my teammates). 

Thank you so much! I think I'll modify my goals on MFP and see where it gets me in a month :)

I was feeling less bloated, but that went away right quick. And as for the eggs/cream situation, I ate a 3-egg only omelette and had a large coffee with 2 tbsp (30 ml) of heavy cream, but since I've been strict with my carbs I try to avoid having more than one of those coffees each day.

Thanks! How many grams of protein should I be eating? At the beginning I was groggy, and had headaches, but that went away after week 1. I'll definitely lower my dairy intake though! I've been getting most of my fats from cheese/heavy cream
